psychological_meaning: Stromboli, a muted, earthy green, evokes feelings of tranquility and stability. It represents growth, nature, and a connection to the earth. This color can also inspire feelings of calmness and security, promoting a sense of balance and harmony. It is a color that encourages introspection and a grounded perspective.
